keywords: 8 秒槽与 2 到 3 分钟最终性
summary: Vitalik 发表《加密世界计算机》，尝试简洁表达 Hegotá 之后的分叉计划的真正含义：以太坊不再只是区块链，而是一种混合体。barnabemonnot 认为，若 Hegotá 完成更快的槽，2028 年初可能实现 8 秒槽和 2 到 3 分钟最终性。EIP-8425 量子冻结与账户恢复提交为 EIP 草案。

items.title: Vitalik：加密世界计算机
items.note: 17:45，尝试以较简洁的方式表达从 Hegotá 之后的分叉开始计划中的几乎所有变化的真正含义：以太坊已经不只是区块链，而是一种混合体（帖子较长，此处只引用可见部分）。
items.note_en: 17:45, an attempt to express concisely the true meaning of basically everything planned starting from the fork after Hegotá: Ethereum is really not just a blockchain anymore, but a hybrid (the post is long, and only the visible part is cited here).

summary_en: Vitalik published "The cryptographic world computer", an attempt to concisely express the true meaning of the forks planned after Hegotá: Ethereum is no longer just a blockchain but a hybrid. barnabemonnot argued that if faster slots ship in Hegotá, 8-second slots and 2 to 3 minute finality could arrive by early 2028.
